description: Regolith filter that compiles MDX guide content (data/guides/<locale>/**) into a guide IR manifest plus auto-localized .lang entries.

namespace.description: Addon namespace used in generated localization keys (<namespace>.guides.*). Defaults to the <creator>_<pack> join read from the core.register() call under BP/scripts; set it only to override that scan.

sourceDir.description: Guide content root, relative to the Regolith temp directory. Direct children are locale folders (en_US, es_ES, ...); the filter's own data files sit beside them.

defaultLocale.description: Locale that defines document structure, keys, sidebar, and fallback values. Must exist under sourceDir.

include.description: Glob patterns (relative to each locale folder) selecting guide pages.

exclude.description: Glob patterns excluding pages matched by include.

manifestPath.description: Output path for the guide IR manifest, relative to the Regolith temp directory.

maxCodeLineBytes.description: Hard-wrap budget (UTF-8 bytes) for code block lines — code is raw un-localized text, which the runtime caps at 80 bytes.

strictLocales.description: Fail the build (instead of warning) when a locale's keys drift from the default locale.

compileScreens.description: Write one generated *.screen.tsx per page (plus the home index) under screensDir, for the ui-compiler filter to bake into the pack. Off, the guide renders only through createGuide at runtime.

screensDir.description: Where the generated screen modules go, relative to the Regolith temp directory. Must sit under the scripts folder the ui-compiler filter scans.

screenTitle.description: Header title baked into every compiled guide screen (raw text, colorable).

componentsModule.description: Module whose default export is the registry of components MDX `cmp` blocks may use (a GuideComponents record), relative to the Regolith temp directory, e.g. BP/scripts/guides/components.tsx. Empty, a cmp block renders the unsupported-content placeholder on compiled screens.
